CSHB.name: Cash Back
CSHB.definition: Purchase of goods or services with cashback

INTP.name: Instant Payment
INTP.definition: Instant payment from a cardholder's account to an acceptor's account

INTT.name: Instant Transfer
INTT.definition: Instant transfer of funds from a payer's account to a payee's account.

OTHN.name: Other National
OTHN.definition: Other type of additional service at national level

OTHP.name: Other Private
OTHP.definition: Other type of additional service at private level

PRST.name: Pre Staged Transaction
PRST.definition: Withdrawal transaction was pre-authorised by another channel (amount could be absent).

BALC.name: Account Balance
BALC.definition: Return the account balance with the transaction.
